facts.statement: Schizooura is classified as a basal ornithuromorph dinosaur, making it a relative of modern birds.
facts.quote: Schizooura is a genus under the classification of basal ornithuromorph dinosaurs, which are dinosaurs that are relatives of modern birds.

facts.statement: Schizooura was a feathery creature that lived 125.5 million years ago in western Liaoning, China.
facts.quote: This feathery creature was from the Early Cretaceous period (125.5 million years ago) in modern-day western Liaoning, China

facts.statement: Schizooura was a ground forager that collected food from the floor.
facts.quote: The Schizooura was a ground forager, meaning it collected whatever it could find from the floor.

facts.statement: Schizooura had a toothless beak, distinguishing it from other modern birds.
facts.quote: The bird evolved differently compared to other modern birds, as its beak is toothless.

facts.statement: Schizooura remains were discovered in the Jiufotang Formation deposits.
facts.quote: The remains were discovered in Jiufotang Formation deposits.

facts.statement: Only one fossil of Schizooura has ever been discovered, making it relatively unknown.
facts.quote: Any information about the bird is relatively unknown, as only one fossil was ever discovered.

facts.statement: The only known specimen, IVPP V 16861, is an articulated nearly complete skeleton with feather impressions found in the Jiufotang Formation in western Liaoning, China.
facts.quote: El espécimen holotipo y único conocido, IVPP V 16861, se encontró en la Formación Jiufotang en el Liaoning occidental, China; se trata de un esqueleto articulado casi completo con impresiones de las plumas

facts.statement: Initial phylogenetic analysis places Schizooura as more primitive than Hongshanornis.
facts.quote: Un análisis filogenético inicial lo sitúa como más primitivo que Hongshanornis.

facts.statement: Schizooura lived between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)
